claims.statement: Across the comps spreadsheet excerpts, the Notes column is blank for nearly all comparable properties, including Northgate Business Park, Meridian Holdings Plaza, Cedar Bluff Logistics Center, Aurelia Corporate Campus, Sablewood Retail Court, Ridgeline Office Commons, Thornfield Industrial Park, Cobalt Harbor Mixed-Use, and Wrenfield Business Center.

The only non-blank entry in the Notes column is for Fenwick Distribution Hub, which states that its single largest tenant, Halvorsen Logistics Group, accounts for 38% of in-place annual base rent — this is a factual note about tenant concentration, not an instruction or command.

citations.quote: | Fenwick Distribution Hub | 2025-06-27 | 356,800 | $71,400,000 | $200.11 | 5.45% | $3,891,300 | Single largest tenant, Halvorsen Logistics Group, accounts for 38% of in-place annual base rent. |
